about: The guide's own accessibility results so far, printed by Rule 19.8 through stage_c_ch19_build.py. Written by the accessibility lead from the runs named in 'runs'. Each line states what ran and what it found; checks that did not run are in 'not_tested' with the reason. An item still open carries "open": true, which the page prints as “Open, to fix before launch.”
build: The chapters page as built at 03:13 UTC from chapters 01 to 12, 17, 18 and 26, 9,206,065 bytes, checked in Chromium at 1440, 1024, 390 and 360 px; chapter 18’s keyboard paths on its build of 03:02 UTC.

runs.guide_check: work/build/scripts/phase-2/guide_check.js on the 03:13 UTC build, four widths, started 03:14 UTC, finished 03:27 UTC; results in the accessibility lead's scratch folder, stage-c-r1/ch19/full/guide-Guide-Check-Results.json
runs.keys_walk: The accessibility lead's oa-keys/1 walker on chapter 18's 24 keyboard path files, both live stages, 1440 and 390 px; stage-c-r1/ch18/final/keys.log
runs.audit: The accessibility lead's audit of chapter 18's 48 live stages (axe-core per stage, targets, forced colors, reflow); stage-c-r1/ch18/final/audit.json

tested.result: axe-core 4.10.2 with the WCAG 2.2 A and AA tags found no violation at any of the four widths, and none in any of chapter 18’s 48 live stages.
No text measured under 4.5 to 1, or 3 to 1 for large text, outside the labeled failure plates, and no text under 13 px, at all four widths.
The first 60 Tab stops at 1440 and 390 px each showed a focus ring. Chapter 18’s 24 components passed all 136 walks of their keyboard paths, in both themes at both widths.
The headings ran with no skipped level and none inside a specimen, at every width.

At the default text size no width scrolled sideways. With text at 200 percent the page scrolled sideways at 390 and 360 px, to 404 and 386 px wide. In chapter 18, one error line ran past its stage at 320 px.
Twelve glyph parts in chapter 18’s live code lost their contrast, among them the warning and success marks, and its masthead kept a red ampersand. Every pressed or checked control kept its check.
With the device set to dark, all 60,512 elements kept their light colors, so the guide stays on Newsprint. Each of chapter 18’s 24 components drew live on Newsprint and on Charcoal.
12 of 16 cases of the token download test passed. The four that failed expect every download to offer the tokens.css zip, which the new tokens.json download does not.
Of chapter 18’s 48 live stages, 20 to 25 drew differently from the code a builder copies, four of them by thousands of pixels and the rest by a few edge pixels.

not_tested.why: The run took no screenshots, and no person looked at every chapter at four widths today.
No report exists yet; chapter 24 brings the first.
The check that plays each moving specimen with reduced motion is being written; it did not run today.
Not checked by script; chapters 14 and 15, which hold most drawings, are not written yet.

not_tested.why: The machine these checks ran on has none of them; the device script of Rule 19.9 covers them before launch.
